essence: Concept impresses the self unaided → fallen from bondage by pure-knowledge grace, Lord-power-form relied on → śākta knowledge brought forth.
The claim is settled in the next ahnika — cross-reference, nothing more.
Concept depending on another means → āṇava knowledge: mind/breath/body/pot as limited means, each typed by its sound.

Fitting meditation: self-luminous supreme tattva in own-heart → knower-instrument-known union as fire-sun-moon → great Bhairava-fire → wheel-emergent rests external → four-fillings moon/sun/fire/anuttara.
The wheel completes with every external-thing division.
With that wheel the residual habit-states get meditated too.
Unceasing meditator determining consciousness-real series and creation-autonomy → Bhairava-state at once.
Practice yields all desired attainments and more.
The triad placed within: self-luminous all-self-tattva, measure-and-rest.
Entered within, standing: meditation in the heart-bliss abode.
The object: twelve-great-power-ray-wheel-Lord, all-pervading.
Emerging by ethers outside: meditation on creation-bearing states.
The swallowing-all mandala of outer-inner being rests in self.
Resting-contemplating yogin becomes the spread of self itself.
Summary-verses close the meditation list.
Meditation section ends here.
Articulating breath: heart-emptiness → breath-arising outside → apāna-moon-filling all-selfness → desiring-no-other → samāna union-rest → udāna grasps measure-measured.
At swallowing-fire pacification, vyāna-arising flashes devoid of limitation.
From emptiness to vyāna: six bliss-levels — own to consciousness — plus the connector world-bliss, rise-and-set-free.
Articulation-levels: resting two-wise or wholly, rest-tattva apart from body-breath is attained.
Keep the seed-articulation secret, impress concept; each rest carries five states by entry-depth.
First rest: bliss from fullness-contact → arising in embodimentlessness → tremor loosening body-identity → sleep from outwardness-dissolution.
Non-self dissolves in self from all-pervasiveness → fifth state: whirling from great-pervasion.
The five states span waking to beyond-fourth.
They occur at the triangle-root-heart-kuṇḍalinī-wheel entry-points.
Articulation-rest triad of marks: supreme pulsation-dissolved, dawning, already-dawned — said at proper time.
The supreme mark here: yogini-heart.
Primary pulsation-form: contraction-expansion as pair, reaching visarga-portion-rest — enough.
This entry is non-luminous.
Own-knowing first, then knowable-rest, then complete the knowable.
At completion he rests on measurer-measured distinction — withdraw swift.
Pervading-then-resting: six means-levels stand with emptiness.
Breath-and-rest are not-after-vyāna; dissolved in it, the waking-manifestation series.
Practice-established grows before long in the creation-dissolution contemplation-abode.
Inner-verses close the inner section.
Articulation section ends.
Flashing letter almost-imitating-unmanifest: primary in creation-dissolution-seed; its practice gains supreme-consciousness; unify heart-throat-lips, twelve-end-pair, heart — letter-secret.
Some say: white-yellow inner letter born after inner-touch-contemplation manifests consciousness-experience.
Without expressible: consciousness-pulsation runs on moon-sun-motion checks.
Equal entry completes the consciousness-seed-mass letter-form.
Inner-verse closes.
Letter-rule section ends.
Mudrā-revelation operation comes next.

rasa.dominant: śānta with abhyāsa weight (quiescence as disciplined practice)
rasa.justification: The relish is methodical ascent: each stage names its condition, each rest its states, each section its colophon — calm is the practice's own texture; the Bhairava-state at u7 and the vyāna-flash at u18 are the two brief lights in it.

sections.FUNCTION: Teaches the three upāya-knowledge types (śākta/āṇava via vikalpa), the heart-dhyāna with its four-fillings, the six-stage prāṇa-uccāra through six bliss-levels, the five avasthās per rest, and the varṇa-rahasya of uccāra — closing with the mudrā forward-reference.
sections.KEY TERMS: vikalpa as upāya (self-impressing concept); śākta/āṇava jñāna (power-form vs instrument-form knowledge); mahābhairavāgni (meditation-fanned fire); catur-viśrānti (moon/sun/fire/anuttara fillings); ṣaḍ-ānanda-bhūmi (six bliss-levels + jagad-ānanda connector); pañca-avasthā per viśrānti (ānanda→ghūrṇi); liṅga-traya (spandana/ unmiṣat/ unmiṣita); varṇa-rahasya (avyaktānukṛti-dhvani, hṛt-kaṇṭha-oṣṭha unification).
sections.LOCAL CONTEXT: Āhnika 5 bridges dhyāna (u1-16) → uccāraṇa (u17-36) → varṇa-vidhi (u37-42); the mudrā forward-ref (u43) opens ahnika 6; v2's 'next ahnika' closes the vikalpa-knowledge question posed in a04.
sections.BOUNDARY: Five avasthās per rest asserted with only four named here (fifth arrives u23); kecit white/yellow-varṇa view recorded not adopted; samaya-neglect 'complete' stated without which conventions are meant; liṅga-traya deferred to 'proper time' — never resolved here.
sections.EXPLANATION: The ahnika runs: knowledge-types by vikalpa-dependence → the heart-dhyāna (triadic union + four cosmic fillings) → practice-results and the placed triad → breath-articulation in six stages yielding six bliss-levels → five states per rest (ānanda to ghūrṇi) → the liṅga-traya and primary spanda → completion-order (svabodha→meya) → the letter's dhvani and its unification method. Each section closes with its own colophon (dhyāna/uccāraṇa/varṇa-vidhi).
sections.RELATED: GRETIL Tantrasāra ahnika 5 (KSTS 17); a04's vikalpa question (answered v1-3); mudrā-prakāśana = a06 topic; a03's bīja-scheme (varṇa doctrine kin); qa NEEDS_WITNESS expected.
